title: ObservationRecord
description: Normalized observation record schema with point-in-time provenance and causal ordering (C2-R02)

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this observation record

source_id.description: Identifier of the registered source document

source_url.description: Origin URL or path of the source document

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the raw source payload

category.description: Observation category: EARNINGS, FILING, GUIDANCE, MACRO, SENTIMENT

event_at.description: Timestamp when the real-world event occurred (UTC ISO-8601)

published_at.description: Timestamp when the document or announcement was published (UTC ISO-8601)

available_at.description: Timestamp when the document was publicly accessible for decisions (UTC ISO-8601)

ingested_at.description: Timestamp when this record was ingested by the local system (UTC ISO-8601)

timezone.description: Source timezone name or UTC offset (e.g. UTC, America/New_York, +00:00)

value.description: Extracted numerical or categorical value. NULL must not be coerced to 0.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. USD, PERCENT, RATIO)

quality_flags.description: Quality flags (e.g. MISSING_DATA, AMENDED, REVISED, CAUSAL_VERIFIED)
